features: 40-key compact layout delivers an efficient gaming-focused setup while saving valuable desk space.
Rainbow Backlit lighting adds an eye-catching gaming atmosphere and enhances your setup.
Full Anti-Ghosting technology helps register multiple key presses accurately during fast-paced gameplay.
USB Plug & Play connectivity enables quick and convenient setup without complicated installation.
Palm Rest Design provides comfortable hand support for extended gaming and everyday use.
Backed by a 1-year limited warranty from FRONTECH for added product support.
description: Level up your gaming setup with the FRONTECH NoxBlade KB-0008A Gaming Keyboard. Designed with a compact 40-key layout, vibrant Rainbow Backlit lighting and Full Anti-Ghosting for responsive key input during intense gaming sessions. The Palm Rest Design provides added comfort, while the USB Plug & Play interface makes setup quick and simple. It includes a Type-C Adapter and features an approx. 1.5m cable. Compatible with Windows XP, 2000, ME, Vista, 7, 8, 10 and 11.
